label: dbt show current model
args:
set -euo pipefail
file="$1"
project_dir="$2"
dbt_command="$3"
limit="${4:-}"
if [[ ! -f "$project_dir/dbt_project.yml" ]]; then
  echo "dbt_project.yml was not found at $project_dir" >&2
  exit 1
fi
relative_file="${file#$project_dir/}"
if [[ "$relative_file" == "$file" ]]; then
  echo "$file is not inside $project_dir" >&2
  exit 1
fi
selector="path:$relative_file"
if [[ "$dbt_command" == "show" ]]; then
  limit="${limit:-100}"
  echo "dbt show --select $selector --limit $limit"
  exec dbt show --project-dir "$project_dir" --select "$selector" --limit "$limit"
fi
echo "dbt $dbt_command --select $selector"
exec dbt "$dbt_command" --project-dir "$project_dir" --select "$selector"
